dct_creator_sm: Korsmit, Iza (McGill University, Leiden University). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0003-4750-1710
dct_description_sm:
For supplementary materials of the below publication, see Analysis/Thesis_Ch3 for all files necessary for analysis, and folders Exp1 and Exp2 for the data and stimuli of both experiments:
Korsmit, I. R., Montrey, M., Wong-Min, A., & McAdams, S. (2023, September 6). A Comparison of Dimensional and Discrete Models for the Representation of Perceived and Induced Affect in Response to Short Musical Sounds. https://doi.org/10.31234/osf.io/2sby9

This dataset contains the stimuli, rating and questionnaire data, as well as all files necessary for the analyses that were reported in the thesis "An investigation of affective timbres: Considering affect locus, experimental context, and individual differences" by Korsmit (2023), and related publications in peer-reviewed journals (see notes).
dct_title_s: Stimuli, Data, and Rscripts for thesis: "An investigation of affective timbres: Considering affect locus, experimental context, and individual differences"
